runs.name: ENN Energy Holdings Limited; OTC ADS XNGSY at four ordinaries per ADS, Hong Kong 2688, no SEC annual report, read from its own annual reports in RMB; a Chinese city-gas distributor
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: Price **HK$50.15** a share (Hong Kong close 2026-10-16) and **US$25.54 an ADS** (OTC close 2026-10-16), both Yahoo, **aggregator, live quote only, flagged**; ADS ratio four ordinary shares per ADS (F-6EF of 2019-11-22, JPMorgan Chase Bank, SEC CIK 0001454948, ADR F-6 filings only); CFETS central parity 2026-10-16 HKD/CNY 0.85658, USD/CNY 6.7220. Shares 1,131,839,264 in issue, no treasury shares, at 2026-09-30 (Monthly Return of Equity Issuer submitted 2026-10-02, HKEXnews), 19,984,600 held by the award-scheme trustee counted as outstanding; `Screens/cover_shares.py` and `tools/run.py` returned not an SEC filer, all arithmetic by hand in the research folder's scripts. Sovereign for the earnings currency (RMB) **2.06%**, ChinaBond Government Bond Yield Curve 30-year point, 2026-10-16 (China Central Depository & Clearing, the Ministry of Finance's depository; tenor chosen to match the protocol's USD line; no RMB row in the table). Read from the Annual Report 2025 (HKEXnews 2026-04-28), the Annual Reports 2016 to 2024, the Interim Report 2026 (2026-09-17), the 2025 and 2026 HKEXnews announcements and the company's results presentations. Cross-check: operating cash flow FY2025 RMB 10,433m in the cash-flow statement agrees with the Financial Review. Event named: ENN-NG, the 34.28% controlling shareholder, proposed a privatisation by scheme on 2025-03-26 at a stated HK$80.00 in shares and cash; it lapsed on 2026-06-12 on unfulfilled pre-conditions, ENN-NG stating it intends to raise its holding, Rule 31.1 barring a new offer for twelve months. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's MD&A, Financial Review, risk table, notes and Directors' Report, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: a regulated city-gas distributor, 264 projects, 32.76m households, revenue RMB 111.9bn. **Q2 IN**: retail gas decides at 43.8% of five-year segment profit, none above half; exclusive city franchises, the regulator-bounded return carried to Q3 as a second best; narrowing: the dollar margin RMB 0.73 a cubic metre in 2016 to 0.51 in 2021 with gas cost not fully passed through, connection profit down 63% 2021 to 2025, a one-city-one-enterprise policy named in the risk table. **Q3 weighs against**: capital employed up RMB 11.8bn 2021 to 2025 while after-tax operating earnings fell RMB 2.2bn; spending 2.0 to 2.8 times depreciation, about RMB 6.0bn of capex guided for 2026 on flat to slight volume growth. **Q4 weighs against, no STOP**: core profit, EBITDA and annual guidance in the headlines; ten balance sheets, attributable equity RMB 15.0bn to 47.8bn, borrowings RMB 17bn to 22bn throughout, net debt to equity 54% to 20.5%, goodwill and intangibles 14% of equity. **Q5 integrity IN, ability for**: controller dealings recorded, not judged: the 2018 purchase from the Wang family for RMB 2.6bn paid wholly in new shares, about 77% goodwill; about RMB 3.8bn of 2025 purchases from companies Mr. Wang controls; the lapsed offer; no litigation, penalty or investigation found. **Q6 weighs against on both parts**: about RMB 32bn retained over ten years earning roughly 3.7%; the 2018 all-stock deal does not meet the STOP's condition, the stock not undervalued then. **Q7 OUT on the floor**: owner cash after every real cost (all spending and acquisitions deducted) 2021 to 2025 3,358, 3,312, 2,475, 2,908, 3,710 (RMB m), average 3,153 all-equity, 2,764 equity-only; floor tested first, expected return 5.41% no-growth and 6.55% shown growth all-equity, 6.00% and 7.23% equity-only. Value range RMB 133.70 to 171.27 a share all-equity at the sovereign (HK$156.09 to 199.95; US$79.56 to 101.92 an ADS); **fair price RMB 20.35 = HK$23.76 = US$12.11 an ADS all-equity**, equity-only RMB 27.80 = HK$32.45 = US$16.54 an ADS. The deciding judgment is Q7 (e): no maintenance figure is filed, so all capital spending was charged; the depreciation variant, shown beside as COMPUTATION, returns 11.8% at the price and would turn the file on the screamer test at about HK$44. The annual reports name no rival; CR Gas, China Gas and Towngas Smart Energy chosen as a CONVENTION of the run, none an SEC filer, read from summary tables: average return on equity 2016-20 then 2021-25 ENN 17.3% to 15.7%, CR Gas 17.3% to 11.7%, China Gas 21.7% to 7.2%, Towngas SE 7.5% to 6.0%. Conventions of the run confessed in the owner-cash definitions (award-trust purchases charged as pay, minority cash deducted, the payable dividend in net debt). Contamination declared by the analyst: ENGGY commit subjects with its box and figures, a filtered Test Runs listing returning LEN and PENN file names, the project map and memory index, none used. Process shortfall declared by the analyst: most reading and arithmetic done before Q1 was written, a draft of Q6's buyback line committed one commit before Q7. Commits 77109fa0 (template), 8e1b6195 (Step 0 and Q1), 9037144a (Q2 and Q3 in one commit), 56ae5044 (Q4), b29e3ab5 (Q5), 399be876 (Q6), fd9734db (Q7 with the buyback line written back), a3bc9d45 (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 100 ids, no E-ids, 31 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): what 'where the filing allows the maintenance guess' in Q7 (e) requires, which here decides the box; how the width and screamer tests read when the sovereign sits far below the floor; no RMB row in the sovereign table; 'expected return at the price' undefined, and the after-year-ten stop of purchases in the no-growth case; shares bought by an award trust under Q6; minority interests on the all-equity basis; a dividend payable on the latest balance sheet.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor (ENN Energy, a Chinese city-gas distributor read from its own annual reports in RMB; Q1 IN, Q2 IN on exclusive city franchises at a regulator-bounded return carried as a second best, the gas margin and connection profit narrowing; Q3, Q4 and Q6 against, spending at two to nearly three times depreciation with owner cash flat; Q5 integrity IN with the controlling family's dealings and the lapsed 2025 privatisation recorded; expected return 5.41% no-growth and 6.55% shown growth all-equity; value range RMB 133.70 to 171.27 at the 2.06% sovereign, fair RMB 20.35 a share, US$12.11 an ADS, equity-only US$16.54; the deciding judgment Q7 (e), the depreciation variant at 11.8% shown beside; armed at the all-equity ADS figure. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: what allows the maintenance guess, the width and screamer tests at a very low sovereign, no RMB sovereign row, expected return undefined, award-trust shares, minority interests, a payable dividend.)
